headline: AI Data Center Power Supplier Stocks Decline Ahead of Earnings
summary: Shares of companies supplying power hardware and infrastructure to AI data centers have dropped a median 23 percent from early October record highs, despite sustained capital spending by large technology firms.
why: Power equipment suppliers are essential hardware vendors powering the expansion of cloud compute and artificial intelligence data centers.
why_moved: Valuation pressure on key infrastructure suppliers reflects investor caution over near-term profit margins and earnings releases.
